messages:
mira: Quick heads-up — BigCorp legal just pushed back: they want a pinned model option with a contractual TTL and a guaranteed benchmark before we commit. They asked for a 6-month pin and a per-release compatibility check. Can ops/product/eng weigh in on feasibility?

jon: 6mo pin is heavy. Do we mean absolute pin (no auto-updates) or soft pin that falls back to a migration shim?

mira: They want absolute pin for stability during integration. Sales offered longer commitment if we can guarantee perf and an escape hatch.

sam: Absolute pin for 6mo -> infra & capacity risk. We can support, but need canary lanes + capacity reservation or a reserved instance product. Also need clear rollback plan if we detect perf regressions.

lex: From ML side: we need benchmark suites per customer workload. A single LLM perf/quality number won't cut it. Suggest minimum gates: embedding cosine recall >= baseline on their eval set, generation BLEU/ROUGE-ish parity within X%, and p99 latency delta < 20%.

anika: +1 for concrete thresholds. Also add token-cost delta < 15% compared to their current pin target. Finance will push if cost moves more than that.

mira: Agree. Can we draft an operational launch checklist and the exact metrics we will sign against? Sales needs that for the SOW.

jon: I'll sketch a minimum checklist: 1) customer-specific bench run (seeded eval) 2) perf run at target QPS with KV-cache warmed 3) canary traffic (1% -> 10% -> 100% over 48h) 4) monitoring/alerts (latency, error-rate, quality-drift) 5) rollback policy + automated fallback route.

sam: For perf run, we should capture these traces: p50/p95/p99 latency, tail spike count, GPU mem pressure, and token/sec. I'll paste the perf command we use in infra:

```
./bench_runner --model redwood/open-vX --qps 50 --seq 512 --warmup 300 --runs 20 --capture p50,p95,p99,gpu_mem,token_rate
```

lex: For quality, we'll run their subset through eval harness. Need to agree on which prompts are in-scope. Sales/solutions should own collecting that.

anika: Sales can collect, but legal wants the SOW to list the exact eval artifacts. We should avoid including production PII prompts. Use synthetic anonymized set + customer-provided non-PII examples.

mira: Ops-bot: create a triage ticket for this customer onboarding and link runbook?

ops-bot: Created ticket PRODUCT-7621 with checklist template and assigned to @jon, @lex, @sam. ETA: 5 working days. :white_check_mark:

jon: On canary lanes — recommend a soft pin flow: customer routes 100% of their tenant to pinned model in dedicated capacity. We still keep an auto-fallback to a compatible variant in hosted pool if latency or errors exceed thresholds. That respects the absolute pin while providing safety.

sam: We need autoscaler caps on that dedicated pool and a surge plan. Recommend reserved capacity with a small burst buffer plus a manual escalation path.

mira: Contract ask: customer wants ability to extend pin for extra 6 months but only if both parties agree. We can offer an opt-in renewal clause in SOW with a performance re-check.

lex: For the re-check, propose: run the same bench suite on the pinned version and the new candidate within a 7-day window; quality regressions > 3% or latency > 15% triggers no renewal.

anika: Finance OKs those thresholds as long as we have token-cost guardrail. Add a clause: if token-cost delta > 10% we reserve right to renegotiate price for renewal.

mira: Next steps: jon to prepare ops checklist + perf command examples; lex to prepare eval plan and metric thresholds; sam to estimate capacity/cost and reserved capacity ask; sales to draft SOW language with opt-in renewal + audit window. Back here in 3 business days for final SOW text.

jon: I'll post the draft checklist in this thread when ready.

lex: will prep eval scripts and an anonymization checklist.

sam: starting capacity estimate now, will attach rough numbers to ticket by EOD tomorrow.

anika: I'll mock the renewal clause language and share with legal for quick review.

mira: Perfect. Thanks everyone. If any blockers surface ping me directly. :rocket:
